Uses specific remembered details: Normal People, the Sally Rooney pick, the 10 pm block, the scrolling reason.
Raises the open Sally Rooney pick once, in passing; the timer screenshot ask is a proof ask, not a second follow-up item.
Gives a short prose summary, not an inventory, then asks 'Anything I got wrong?'; the invented specifics weaken the honesty of the summary.

conversation.reason: Summary covers the expected tree facts and asks if anything's off, but it asserts unsupported details (train, cafe closing shifts, midterms), which the case says it shouldn't claim.

grade.summary: ZOH gave a warm, well-shaped 'what do you know' summary that covers Maya's econ studies, the reading-to-scrolling reason, the Sally Rooney follow-up and the 10 pm block, then asked if anything was off. It did add several details that aren't in the memory shown (the train, the cafe closing shifts, midterms, night owl), which is the main miss.
